newsitem.title: USA: Blue Cross of Northeastern Pa. board oks merger.
newsitem.headline: Blue Cross of Northeastern Pa. board oks merger.

text.p: Blue Cross of Northeastern Pennsylvania said Thursday its board has approved an agreement to merge with Capital Blue Cross of Harrisburg.
Blue Cross said the Capital Blue Cross board had already endorsed the terms of the agreement.

The company said it hopes to complete the merger by Jan. 1, 1998. It said the next step in the process will involve incorporating terms of the deal into a definitive agreement for approval by each organization's corporate memberships.
After internal approvals, the agreement will be submitted to state and federal regulators for review, it said.
